review_candidates.description: A leading organisation is seeking a highly experienced Head of IT Operations to guide and transform its IT Operations function across both enterprise technology and manufacturing environments . This pivotal role offers the opportunity to shape the future of technology services, ensuring secure, reliable, and highly available systems that underpin business continuity and growth. You will be empowered to lead a diverse team, drive operational excellence, and partner with senior management to deliver strategic improvements. What you'll do: * Lead the IT Operations function covering Infrastructure, Network, Core Systems, ERP, Manufacturing Systems, Application Support, Service Desk and End-User Support by providing guidance and direction to ensure seamless operations. * Develop and execute the IT Operations strategy, roadmap, budget and operating model that aligns closely with business goals and Enterprise Technology objectives. * Ensure availability, reliability, performance and scalability of all business-critical IT systems and infrastructure by implementing best practices and monitoring frameworks. * Establish and manage comprehensive ITSM frameworks including SLA/KPI management for Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request Management to maintain high standards of service delivery. * Oversee infrastructure operations such as network management, cloud services, data centre maintenance, backup procedures, disaster recovery planning and business continuity measures. * Partner with Cybersecurity teams to strengthen patch management processes, vulnerability remediation efforts, operational security protocols and overall IT resilience. * Manage the entire lifecycle of IT assets including software licensing compliance, CMDB accuracy, vendor performance evaluation and technology contract negotiations. * Drive root-cause analysis initiatives alongside continuous improvement projects aimed at reducing critical incidents and enhancing service availability across all platforms. * Lead automation efforts within IT Operations by introducing self-service tools and operational efficiency initiatives that minimise manual processes while improving user experience. * Ensure operational readiness for new technology deployments including ERP/system implementations as well as broader business transformation initiatives by coordinating cross-functional teams. * Structure the IT Operations team through capability development programmes, performance management strategies and succession planning activities to build a resilient workforce. * Provide regular updates on IT Operations performance metrics along with risk assessments and improvement recommendations directly to senior management. What you bring: * Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or related field is required for foundational technical knowledge. * At least 12 years of proven experience in IT roles including 5 years in an IT Operations leadership capacity demonstrates your depth of expertise. * Experience in positions such as Head of IT Operations or Director-level roles involving infrastructure oversight is essential for understanding complex environments. * Strong background managing enterprise infrastructure including networks, cloud platforms, ERP/core systems as well as service operations is vital for success. * Familiarity supporting manufacturing environments (MES/ERP/SAP/manufacturing systems) is preferred * Comprehensive knowledge of ITSM methodologies (ITIL), SLA/KPI frameworks plus Incident/Problem/Change Management processes ensures effective governance. * Good understanding of cybersecurity operations including vulnerability management protocols plus backup/disaster recovery/business continuity strategies is important for maintaining resilience. * Proven track record managing budgets alongside vendor relationships/contracts/technology asset lifecycles highlights your organisational skills. * Experience leading multi-functional teams while engaging senior business stakeholders showcases your interpersonal abilities. * Demonstrated history of driving transformation projects-automation/service improvement/operational optimisation-reflects your commitment to continuous enhancement. * Strong stakeholder management coupled with problem-solving capabilities enables you to navigate complex situations effectively. What sets this company apart: This organisation stands out for its unwavering commitment to employee development through structured training opportunities designed to nurture both technical proficiency and leadership potential. What's next: If you are ready to take on a transformative leadership role in IT Operations within a supportive environment that values collaboration and professional growth then this opportunity awaits you! Apply today by clicking on the link provided-your next career step starts here. Due to the high volume of applications, our team will only be in touch if your application is shortlisted. review_candidates.title: Information Technology Officer
review_candidates.description: The Legislative Council Secretariat (“the Secretariat”) is looking for high-calibre individuals for appointment as Information Technology Officer in its Information Technology Office of the Administration Division. Under the supervision of The Legislative Council Commission, the Secretariat’s mission is to provide efficient and professional secretariat, research and administrative support for the Legislative Council (“LegCo”), enhance community understanding of the activities of LegCo and ensure an effective avenue for redressing grievances of members of the public. Main duties The main duties of an Information Technology Officer include: (a) conducting artificial intelligence (“AI”) and/or cybersecurity technical research, product analysis and evaluation, project development and implementation; (b) managing daily operations and providing technical support for various information technology (“IT”) systems, cybersecurity tools, business applications and AI-powered solutions; (c) implementing AI-related and/or cybersecurity-related projects, including tender preparation, procurement, system analysis, design, programming, secure configuration, implementation, integration, deployment, testing and user training; (d) assisting in the preparation of funding proposals, cost-benefit analysis and budget control; (e) providing programming and technical support on AI chatbot agents, large language models (“LLMs”), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (“RAG”), virtual assistants, natural language processing, big data analytics and secure AI application development; (f) participating in the development, deployment and system tuning of multimodal LLMs, multiple AI agent solutions and multi-LLM agent collaboration applications, and assisting in the implementation of security controls for AI models, data pipelines, application programming interfaces (“APIs”) and integration interfaces; (g) monitoring the quality of services and performance of vendors of products and services, including their compliance with cybersecurity, data protection and security level requirements; (h) enhancing various business application systems for integration with AI-powered solutions and cybersecurity controls; (i) assisting in cybersecurity operations, including vulnerability scanning, patch management, security log review, access right review, endpoint/server/network security monitoring, security baseline checking, backup and recovery verification, and follow-up on remediation actions; (j) supporting cybersecurity incident response, investigation, evidence collection, reporting and coordination with internal users, vendors and relevant parties; and (k) taking part in any other IT/electronic system project implementation, support, maintenance and cybersecurity duties as required. Entry requirements Applicants should have: (a) a recognized university degree in electronic engineering, computer science, IT, AI engineering, computer engineering, data science, cybersecurity, information security, or equivalent; (b) at least six years of relevant and hands-on experience in planning, designing, programming, implementing, installing, integrating, testing, maintaining, operating, and providing technical support for AI-related, cybersecurity-related or IT systems; (c) proficiency in/knowledge of some of the following work areas/technologies: (i) prompt engineering, RAG techniques, natural language processing, machine learning and deep learning algorithms, multiple AI agents and multi-LLM technologies, API design and system integration; (ii) different LLM setup, configuration and system tuning such as DeepSeek, Alibaba Qwen, iFLYTEK Spark, Kimi, Microsoft Azure OpenAI/GPT, Gemini, Grok, LLaMA, etc.; (iii) mainstream AI frameworks (e.g. TensorFlow, PyTorch) and programming languages (e.g. Python); (iv) cybersecurity operations, including vulnerability scanning, patch management, access control, security hardening, log monitoring, endpoint/server/network security, backup and recovery, security testing and incident handling; (v) common web application, API, cloud and AI security risks; and (vi) cybersecurity standards and good practices, such as the Digital Policy Office’s IT Security Policy and Guidelines, GB/T 22239-2019, GB/T 22240-2020, GB/T 28448-2019, ISO/IEC 27001, cloud security best practices and secure software development lifecycle; (d) an excellent command of written and spoken Chinese and English; (e) very strong analytical, communication, negotiation, problem-solving and supervisory skills; and (f) the ability to work independently as well as under pressure, and to lead junior team members to deliver timely, quality and secure IT services. Experience in supporting security audits, risk assessments, penetration testing, security documentation, incident response, vendor coordination and remediation follow-up would be an advantage. Preference will be given to applicants who possess the following IT professional certifications: AI / Cloud / System Development Certifications Huawei Certified ICT Associate - Artificial Intelligence Alibaba Cloud Associate Generative AI Engineer Microsoft Azure AI Engineer AWS Certified AI Practitioner AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer Certified Professional Python Programming Level 2 (PCPP2) PMI Certified Professional in Managing AI (PMI-CPMAI) Project Management Professional (PMP) Cybersecurity Certifications Certified Information Security Professional (CISP) Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) Certification Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) ISO/IEC 27001 Auditor / Lead Auditor Certified AI Security Professional (CAISP) Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK) All applicants should be willing to work beyond normal office hours and on holidays when needed. The Secretariat may devise further criteria to shortlist applicants. Remuneration The starting salary is $66,075 per month, increasing by five annual increments to $83,140 subject to satisfactory conduct and work performance. There is also a monthly cash allowance for the rank of Information Technology Officer (the current rate is $1,225 per month). Successful applicants will be appointed on three-year agreement terms subject to renewal upon satisfactory completion of service, at which the appointees will be eligible for an end-of-agreement gratuity. The gratuity, when added to the employer’s contribution to a Mandatory Provident Fund Scheme, is equal to 15% of the total basic salary drawn during the agreement period. Fringe benefits include paid leave as well as medical and dental benefits. Application The Secretariat only accepts online applications for the above position. Applicants should apply online on or before 9 October 2026.[Note ] Shortlisted applicants will be notified by email or by phone. All personal data provided will be treated in strict confidence. Applicants not invited for interview within eight weeks from the closing date may assume their applications unsuccessful. As an equal opportunities employer, The Legislative Council Commission is committed to ensuring that there is no discrimination in employment with the Secretariat. The posts advertised are open to all applicants meeting the basic entry requirements irrespective of their disability, gender, marital status, pregnancy, age, family status, sexual orientation and race.
